svg.aria-label: backend-rs: Drop-in replacement for backend/ (FastAPI): same /api/ routes, JSON shapes, status codes and Postgres schema. Alembic remains the schema owner; this crate never migrates or creates tables.

g.text: Port Rust dari backend NaviKarier. Pengganti drop-in untuk backend/ (FastAPI).
Drop-in replacement for backend/ (FastAPI): same /api/* routes, JSON shapes, status codes and Postgres
schema. Alembic remains the schema owner; this crate never migrates or creates tables.
Status: compiles, 6/6 unit tests pass, and tests/compare/compare.py reports **110/110
checks identical** against the Python backend on one Postgres (all 27 endpoints, error
bodies, JSON key order, bcrypt/JWT cross-compat in both directions, the Claude path with retries
against a mock, and 11 PDFs whose extracted text matches PyPDF2 byte for byte). The Docker image
has not been built (no Docker on the dev machine), and nothing ran against production data.
